title: Wants: what a person wants out of life, what it is about, and who tends to want it (fixed decision 12, ADR-0021)

textKey.description: The want in plain words for the inspector ("To keep the camp safe"); a "<key>_you" variant, when present, is used for the player

beatKey.description: The story beat logged when the want forms; a "<key>_you_a" variant is used when the player wants it

pick.description: For a person want: of the people in the camp, the one they get on with best or worst by nature (pair chemistry)

place.description: For a place want: one of the camp's places (shelter, hearth, stockpile, watch_post, covered_ruins)

item.description: For an item want: an items.json id

weights.description: How likely a person is to want this: base plus the adds for each of their traits, their species, their role and (for the player) otherworlder. A total at or below zero means never.
